name: Output Gallery
summary: Displays a scrollable thumbnail grid with lightbox viewer. Collects images from all connected input nodes and renders them in a visual gallery.

inputs.description: Dynamic multiple image inputs. Each connected upstream node contributes one or more images to the gallery.

executionNotes: Terminal display node with no outputs. Maintains a images array of base64 data URLs collected from all connected input edges. Each image is stored as a thumbnail (optimized for fast rendering) and full-resolution version for lightbox. Renders as a responsive grid layout (auto-columns based on viewport width). Clicking a thumbnail opens full-resolution image in lightbox view. Scrollable container supports hundreds of images. No API calls; entirely client-side rendering.

exampleConnections.scenario: Feed generated images from Nano Banana into the gallery for visual review.
Collect extracted frames from multiple videos into a single gallery view.
Route multiple image sources through a router node to consolidate in one gallery.
Display images analyzed or generated by Gemini vision in a gallery.
